summary: Gix Internet Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing commencement of trading of its ordinary shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker GIXI, effective August 31, 2026, concurrently with its existing Tel Aviv Stock Exchange listing. The filing confirms the dual listing and transition to U.S. securities law-based reporting regime under Israeli law. No special situation such as acquisition, tender, or capital return is present; this is a routine listing notice.
